Overview — What is Microsoft 365?

Microsoft 365 (formerly Office 365) is Microsoft's cloud-based productivity platform, trusted by over 345 million users worldwide. It bundles your team's email, calendar, video meetings, document collaboration and cloud storage into a single subscription — hosted on Microsoft's globally distributed Azure infrastructure.

For Indian businesses, Microsoft 365 means your team gets @yourcompany.com professional email, the full Office desktop apps (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), Microsoft Teams for video meetings and chat, and 1 TB OneDrive storage per user — all from one subscription billed in INR with GST. XcellHost provisions the licences, migrates your mail, configures Teams and DNS, and supports it 24×7.

Security & compliance — Microsoft 365

The threat model for Microsoft 365 is identity-first — token theft, business email compromise, consent phishing and unmanaged devices. The controls are chosen to match it: MFA and conditional access before cutover, Defender on every endpoint, and retention set to the policy your auditors actually asked for.

Microsoft 365 (formerly Office 365) is Microsoft's cloud-based productivity suite for businesses. It includes Outlook email, Microsoft Teams, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OneDrive (1 TB cloud storage) and SharePoint — all delivered as subscription services hosted on Microsoft's Azure infrastructure. Plans start at ₹145 per user per month (Business Basic) for web and mobile apps with Teams and Exchange email.

Yes. XcellHost is an authorised Microsoft partner in India. We provision genuine Microsoft 365 licences, handle end-to-end deployment including tenant and Teams setup, DNS configuration and email migration, and provide ongoing managed support — all billed in INR with a GST-compliant invoice.

Business Standard includes the full Office desktop apps — Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook — plus Microsoft Teams, Exchange Online with a 50 GB mailbox, OneDrive (1 TB) and SharePoint. Desktop apps install on up to 5 PCs or Macs, 5 tablets and 5 mobile devices per user.

Business Basic includes web and mobile apps only, plus Exchange email, Teams and OneDrive. Business Standard adds the full desktop apps you install on your PC or Mac. Business Premium adds advanced security: Microsoft Defender for Business, Intune mobile device management, Entra ID Premium P1 and Microsoft Purview compliance tools.

Yes. XcellHost handles complete email migration to Microsoft 365 from any source — including Google Workspace, Zoho Mail, cPanel hosting, Rediffmail and on-premises Exchange servers. Migration includes mailbox data, contacts, calendar events and shared mailboxes with zero data loss and minimal downtime.

Microsoft 365 Copilot is Microsoft's AI assistant integrated directly into M365 apps — Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams and Outlook. Copilot can draft documents, summarise meetings, analyse data in spreadsheets, generate emails and create presentations. It runs on Microsoft's enterprise-grade, privacy-compliant Azure infrastructure and is available as an add-on licence.
